message: dry-run: Standard held at $1,000 a month: $0.03 so far this month. Nothing moved off Standard this month. The Receiver's other services send 7,730 events an hour, under the 1.9 million the budget leaves, and each keeps room to grow 2x. A service the run has not seen gets the larger of the 1.8 million an hour left over and the median service's limits, 1.8 million an hour in all, until the next run, which takes any overshoot back from the rest of the month.
